:::{#sol-prereq-recursion-meaning}

`p(b, n)` computes $b^n$,
the `n`th power of `b`.
Each call multiplies by `b` once,
and the calls stop after `n` multiplications,
when `n` reaches 0.

If this exercise was hard,
review recursion from CSCI 145
before the course reaches [Recursion](recursion.qmd).

:::
